steps.text: Is order less than 30 days old?
steps.quote: The support agent checks whether the order is less than 30 days old.
If it is, the agent sends the customer a returns label.
The customer posts the item back.
The warehouse inspects the returned item.
If the item is undamaged, the finance team issues the refund. If the item is damaged, the support agent tells the customer the refund is refused.
